mapper.update: UPDATE tb_show_event SET available_seats = available_seats - #{seatCount}, locked_seats = locked_seats + #{seatCount}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{showEventId} AND available_seats >= #{seatCount} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE tb_show_event SET locked_seats = locked_seats - #{seatCount}, sold_seats = sold_seats + #{seatCount}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{showEventId} AND locked_seats >= #{seatCount}

UPDATE tb_show_event SET available_seats = available_seats + #{seatCount}, locked_seats = locked_seats - #{seatCount}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{showEventId} AND locked_seats >= #{seatCount}
mapper.select: SELECT city, COUNT(*) as show_count, SUM(CASE WHEN hot_score > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hot_count FROM tb_show_event WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city ORDER BY show_count DESC

SELECT seat_zone, COUNT(*) as total_seats, SUM(CASE WHEN status='AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as available_seats, MIN(price) as min_price FROM tb_seat WHERE show_event_id = #{showEventId} GROUP BY seat_zone ORDER BY seat_zone
